title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Overview of all available action (button) icons/images
summary: The post explains how to find and use action (button) icons from the Dynamics 365 Business Central Action icon library. It covers three methods to access icons: the web-based icon library at aka.ms/bcicons, the AZ AL Dev Tools VS Code extension, and Ctrl+Space IntelliSense in Visual Studio Code.
key_points: Business Central includes a built-in Action icon library with images sized 16x16 pixels by default, or 32x32 pixels for promoted actions
Icons are added to actions using the Image property in AL code
Three main ways to find icons: web library at aka.ms/bcicons, AZ AL Dev Tools VS Code extension with filtering, or Ctrl+Space IntelliSense
If the Image property is not set, no icon will display on the action
Legacy methods for NAV include the Dynamics NAV Image Library tool and direct image downloads

quotes.text: Business Central includes images that you can use on actions in command bar menus and promoted actions on the ribbon.
quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies that Business Central provides built-in icons developers can leverage for UI elements

quotes.text: If you forget to set Image property, no icon will be displayed.
quotes.why_it_matters: Important reminder that the Image property is required to show icons on actions
